verdict.rationale: Salv's own product page says its Monitoring product can be deployed on-premise or in a private cloud, which is a first-party self-hosting option for a core module. But this is a single marketing line with no installation docs or requirements, and it is unclear whether screening, cases or Bridge can also be self-hosted. The API docs only show Salv-hosted 'app' and 'demo' environments. Missing for 10: self-hosting documentation (install, requirements, upgrades), evidence that the whole core platform beyond Monitoring is self-hostable, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Salv Monitoring deploys as cloud, private cloud or on-premise.
